items.name: Awesome Jev by TypeSafe by Anil Matcha
items.short_description: Large community collection of Jev projects, patterns, prompts, and starter code.
items.what_jev_does_here: The repository aggregates links and Jev integration ideas from the launch-week ecosystem.
items.quality_notes: Useful discovery source with heavy overlap and an ambiguous TypeSafe-branded name.
items.verification_notes: The README disclaims official status, but the public title can imply TypeSafe ownership.

items.name: BunsDev TypeSafe AI Playground
items.short_description: Former repository URL for the TypeSafe community playground.
items.what_jev_does_here: The old URL resolves to the current TypeSafeAI playground repository.
items.quality_notes: The canonical project is already recorded under its current repository.
items.verification_notes: GitHub redirects the old repository path to TypeSafeAI/typesafe-playground.

items.name: jev-llm by Code-Forge-AU
items.short_description: Repository cited by secondary posts as a Jev text-generation experiment.
items.what_jev_does_here: Public primary evidence did not confirm a working Jev integration.
items.quality_notes: The project identity and working implementation were not verifiable.
items.verification_notes: Only secondary mentions were found during the review.

items.name: Jev Directory by MagicTeams
items.short_description: Generated directory claiming hundreds of Jev builds and evaluations.
items.what_jev_does_here: The site aggregates submitted Jev projects and evaluation prompts.
items.quality_notes: The underlying records and bulk claims were not independently inspectable.
items.verification_notes: The public source manifest did not support a record-by-record audit.

items.name: Prompt Oscilloscope
items.short_description: Repository described by secondary listings as a Jev prompt-analysis tool.
items.what_jev_does_here: Public primary evidence did not confirm its claimed Jev analysis flow.
items.quality_notes: Discovery came from secondary directories and posts.
items.verification_notes: A usable primary repository page was not confirmed during verification.

items.name: TypeSafe LLaDA Fork
items.short_description: TypeSafe organization fork of the public LLaDA research implementation.
items.what_jev_does_here: The repository does not document a distinct Jev resource or integration.
items.quality_notes: Organization membership alone does not establish Jev relevance.
items.verification_notes: The repository is a fork and lacks a documented Jev-specific role.

items.name: TypeSafe vLLM Fork
items.short_description: TypeSafe organization fork of the public vLLM inference engine.
items.what_jev_does_here: The repository does not document a distinct public Jev implementation.
items.quality_notes: No material public Jev-specific difference was verified.
items.verification_notes: The repository is a fork with no documented Jev resource for this directory.
